To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the pT alpha chain is essential for the development of alpha beta TCR-expressing cells but dispensable for the development of cells that express a gamma delta TCR.

the pre-T cell antigen receptor (pre- TCR) is composed of the pre-T-cell-receptor alpha (pTalpha) chain, the T-cell-receptor beta (TCR-beta) chain, and the CD3 gamma, delta, epsilon and zeta chains, that it is essential for the maturation of alpha beta T-cells and the allelic exclusion of TCR-beta, and that it cannot be fully replaced by an abnormally expressed TCR-alpha beta.

the pre- T cell receptor (pre-T cell receptor) is a heterodimeric transmembrane protein complex that consists of the T cell receptor (TCR) beta chain and the pre-T cell alpha (pTalpha) chain, which is a transmembrane Ig superfamily protein that is expressed on the cell surface of pro-T cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the elucidation of the function of the pT alpha chain in pre-TCR signaling, the molecular mechanism of allelic exclusion of the alpha and beta TCR genes, and the development of T cell subsets.
the structure and function of the pT alpha gene and of the pTalpha chain, and with the function of the preTCR in the maturation of alpha beta TCR-bearing cells.
the structure, function and regulation of the pre-T receptor and its role during thymic development of alpha beta T lymphocytes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the pre- and alpha beta TCR have different functions in T cell development.
the pT alpha chain is an essential part of the pre- T cell receptor that is required for T cell maturation and that the pT-alpha chain is not a surrogate alpha chain for the alpha beta TCR.

the pT alpha gene product is a component of the pre- TCR that is essential for T cell development and that the pre- T cell receptor is the earliest TCR that is functionally expressed in T cell development.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the pre- TCR is a receptor that is expressed at an intermediate stage of T cell differentiation and that is essential for the development of TCR alpha beta-expressing cells but not of TCR gamma delta-expressin cells.
the pre- TCR is a key player for T cell maturation and allelic exclusion of the TCR alpha and beta genes.
the pre- T cell receptor is a key player in the development of alpha beta T lymphocytes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
pT alpha is a unique component of the pre- T cell receptor that is required for the development and maturation of alpha beta T cell receptor-bearing cells.
the pre- TCR is not a mere TCR precursor that is functionally redundant with the mature TCR but is a distinct and indispensable signaling unit that has a unique function in thymocyte maturation.
pre-T cell receptor function is essential for T cell development, but that the pre-T cell receptors are not the only T cell receptors involved in this process.
